conflicts_in.fact: How the Nakuru dataset is grouped in the frequency table built in Lesson 1 and reused later
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 1 builds an ungrouped table listing each unique value (4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12 and so on) with tally and frequency. Lesson 7 uses class intervals of 1–5, 6–10, 11–15, 16–20, 21–25 and 26–31 bags and builds its bar graph 'from the frequency table from Lesson 1'. Lesson 8 uses three groups (1–10, 11–20, 21–31) and calls it the 'grouped frequency table summary from Lesson 1'. Lesson 1 never builds a grouped table.
